source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 Human Capital
source.quote: As of September 26, 2026, the Company had approximately 167,000 full-time equivalent employees.

payroll.label: 2025 annual total compensation of our median compensated employee

source.label: 2026 proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: The 2025 annual total compensation of our CEO was $74,294,811, the 2025 annual total compensation of our median compensated employee was $139,483, and the ratio of these amounts is 533 to 1.

notes: Employees: Apple reports a full-time-equivalent count, not a head count, as of its fiscal year end. Payroll: the FY2026 10-K discloses no total staff cost (no salaries, compensation-and-benefits or employee-cost line), so the proxy's CEO pay ratio median is used. It is the median for fiscal 2025 (employee population at September 27, 2025), from the January 2026 proxy; the fiscal 2026 median will appear only in the proxy due in January 2027. Apple's median includes base salary, bonuses, commissions and the grant-date fair value of equity awards, with annualized salaries for permanent full-time and part-time employees who did not work the full year.
